results.title: U.S. Senate approves Carson City public lands bill
results.description: The bill now heads to the House of Representatives, and if passed, would go to the president’s desk. The bill must pass the House before the end of the 119th Congress. If it doesn’t, the bill would die.

results.title: Chris Van Hollen launches bid for Senate Majority Leader as Schumer’s support shows cracks
results.description: Senate Democrats face a leadership fight as Chris Van Hollen challenges Chuck Schumer. Several senators are undecided, and Bernie Sanders backs Van Hollen. Next month’s vote could reshape the caucus.

results.title: Community Calendar
results.description: The calendar of events is a regular feature of the Owatonna People’s Press. Readers are invited to submit items for publication. Calendar items and events must be open to the public. To submit, email the particulars to editor@apgsomn.com.
